reason: A DSH Web UI plugin and skin collection primarily focused on interface theming and layout enhancements, with additional task automation, visualization, remote access, SSH operations, image understanding, and companion features.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可插拔的主题皮肤、布局面板、移动端远程访问及任务、Git、SSH 和图像理解等扩展功能。
summaries.en: A pluggable collection for DeepSeek Harness Web UI that adds themes, layout panels, mobile remote access, task management, Git visualization, SSH operations, and image understanding.

capabilities: Modifies the DSH Web UI through multiple plugins and skins
Provides task-board scheduling and execution through DSH agent sessions
Provides Git history and branch visualization
Enables remote mobile and PC browser pairing with synchronized workspace access
Provides SSH terminal access, SFTP transfer, port forwarding, and clustered command execution
Sends images to configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints for analysis
Loads local themes, assets, scripts, and wallpaper content
